items.name: NullHandling
items.summary: How [`UnnestOptions`] handles `NULL` and empty list values in the input column.

items.name: RecursionUnnestOption
items.summary: Instruction on how to unnest a column (mostly with a list type) such as how to name the output, and how many level it should be unnested

items.name: UnnestOptions
items.summary: Options for unnesting a column that contains a list type, replicating values in the other, non nested rows.

methods.name: expand_empty_as_null
methods.summary: Returns true if empty input lists should produce a single output row containing `NULL`.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new [`UnnestOptions`] with default values

methods.name: preserve_nulls
methods.summary: Returns true if `NULL` input rows produce a single output row containing `NULL`.

methods.name: with_null_handling
methods.summary: Set the [`NullHandling`] mode used when unnesting `NULL` or empty input lists.

methods.name: with_preserve_nulls
methods.summary: Backward-compatible setter that maps the previous boolean `preserve_nulls` flag onto [`NullHandling`].

methods.name: with_recursions
methods.summary: Set the recursions for the unnest operation
